old_caption: The video shows a close-up view inside a refrigerator, focusing on a shelf where three bottles of purified water are placed. The bottles are clear plastic with blue labels that read "Purified Water" and include additional text and a logo. A hand reaches into the frame from the top right corner, grasping one of the water bottles by its cap. The hand then lifts the bottle slightly, revealing more of the label and the contents inside the bottle. The background includes parts of other items stored in the refrigerator, such as a white appliance and a transparent container. The lighting is bright, illuminating the details of the water bottles and the hand's movement. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent focus on the action of the hand interacting with the water bottle.

caption: Inside a refrigerator, two large plastic water bottles with blue labels stand upright on a white shelf at the left, while a hand from the top right holds a smaller bottle suspended above the shelf. The fingers grip the bottle near its cap, and as it is held the blue label smears and the bottle's orientation shifts in short bursts, indicating it is turning about its vertical axis. The suspended bottle then descends, its ribbed base dropping until the bottle rests upright on the shelf beside the larger ones. Once it stands on its own, the fingers loosen and the hand withdraws upward, leaving only fingertips at the top edge before they recede. Throughout the sequence the two left bottles remain motionless. A faint framing shift nudges them toward the edge, suggesting slight camera movement. The hand hovers near the top as the small bottle sits settled.
